building_admission: Global four scheduled map refreshes per tick in both policies. Proactive initialization shares the one-tick hiring preparation deadline.
comparison: Instrumented baseline/proactive reproduce the previous simulations. Heuristic ablation prepares the same proactive routes but hides them from hiring ranking until a primary prewarm or owner read has used the field. This is a mechanism intervention, not a fixed-world cost counterfactual.
build_command: PYTHONPATH=. scons release=1 CXXFLAGS=-g0 client_profile=full server=0; baseline initially -j8 and final incremental -j4; proactive -j4
instrumentation: Single release binary, runtime policy selection, thread CPU scopes and bucket-entry counters by caller; private-field lifetime ledger. Diagnostic timings include instrumentation overhead and do not replace the prior performance estimates.
limitations: Policies can change game evolution, so total CPU is not isolated kernel cost.
No graphics/frame pacing, other devices or cross-platform coverage.
Contention guard observes native compilers/tests, Docker execution and busy VMs; other host load is not fully controlled.
run_order: Serial paired policies per seed/map, alternate policy and participant order; discard whole paired set upon observed build or VM contention.
